handback.summary: Pull requests a person or Dependabot opens with no plan now pass, unless the setting says otherwise.

criteria.857.1: `dokima/checks.py` main gives a known non-Dokima author's unplanned pull request the passing `unplanned` row; the workflow lets it pass.
criteria.857.2: Same path: Dependabot is a known author other than Dokima's app, so its unplanned pull request gets the passing row.
criteria.857.3: `unplanned_allowed` refuses Dokima's app, so its unplanned pull request keeps the failing no-plan row.
criteria.857.4: `merge.unplanned_prs: allow` in `dokima/defaults.yaml`; any other value keeps the failing no-plan row.

handback.evidence: pytest -q tests/test_unplanned_prs.py and neighbours: 60 passed in 22.62s

raises.label: Unknown author still fails
raises.text: A pull request whose event names no author still fails with no plan, as existing tests expect. Is that right?
raises.evidence: `tests/test_merge_check.py` and `tests/test_text_only.py` events have no user and expect the no-plan row.
